purpose: Backward-compatible, idempotent adaptation of repository-visible Russian product and learner state into generalized append-only evidence.

semantic_inputs.candidate_policy: candidate-* refs remain draft mapping inputs and are never converted into final ru-* semantic IDs by this adapter

global_import_policy.identity_rule: learner_profile_id is the academic-history key; email is never used as stable learner identity
global_import_policy.exact_history_rule: emit one generalized evidence event per source event only when exact source event identity and result are available
global_import_policy.aggregate_rule: when only counters/status/snapshots exist, emit at most one aggregate legacy-import event per stable source record revision; never synthesize a false attempt history
global_import_policy.semantic_rule: resolve semantic targets through the declared mapping version; null/partial mapping remains partial and never becomes guessed exact mastery evidence
global_import_policy.duplicate_application_rule: an existing idempotency tuple or preserved processed source event ID returns already_applied and appends no event/state delta
global_import_policy.correction_rule: later source corrections append linked CORRECTION/RETRACTION events; imported accepted events are not edited in place
global_import_policy.rollback_rule: disable future import and retain source state plus import ledger; do not delete source state or accepted evidence

mapping_rules.rule: preserve stable local profile ID or map through explicit anonymous-profile link; never use email
source.object_type=practice_item and content_version comes from current accepted practice manifest/build
preserve Russian product ID only in versioned subject payload
resolve through 274 mapping version; exact canonical owner only when mapping evidence supports it
preserve raw distinctions; recognition is not transfer and same-session is not delayed retention

aggregate_fallback.output: single AGGREGATE_ONLY legacy-import event per exception_id + updated_at/state_revision
forbidden_inferences: do not generate seen_count synthetic attempt events
do not treat stabilized as canonical mastery
do not treat transfer_passed/retention_passed booleans as independent raw attempts without exact history

mapping_rules.rule: preserve replay suppression; never re-apply an already processed source event
preserve revision as source snapshot identity, not canonical mastery revision
use as snapshot time only; server receive time remains separate

adapters.atomicity_rule: canonical event acceptance and import-ledger insertion are one idempotent operation
adapters.compaction_rule: do not compact processed IDs until an equivalent durable import ledger exists
adapters.mastery_boundary: 120 defines idempotent aggregation only and contributes no universal mastery threshold

exact_activation_gate.output: structured EXACT_RULE_ERROR observation with source locator and mapping provenance

broad_failure_boundary.output: BROAD or UNKNOWN observation without exact exception_id activation
broad_failure_boundary.forbidden: whole-task failure must not become an exact exception error or guessed semantic target

supersession_finding.policy: preserve 114 unchanged, record both refs in provenance, and resolve enabled target against 118 at import time

mapping_rules.rule: preserve trainer item/card identity and content version
aggregate-only import; no synthetic per-attempt history
computed UI summary only; never maps to canonical mastery

adapters.semantic_policy: map card ID through declared crosswalk version; mixed task evidence stays partial/composite
adapters.idempotency_revision: stable hash of the complete item aggregate plus namespace and card ID

adapters.exactness_policy: a checked card can become exact result evidence only when stable session identity, card identity, checked score/max, content version and deterministic semantic mapping are all available
adapters.fallback_policy: otherwise preserve one session/product snapshot as aggregate-only evidence and do not infer exact error positions
adapters.duplicate_policy: derive deterministic source record key from namespace + session.startedAt + card ID; recorded/checked replay appends no duplicate

adapters.canonical_mastery_policy: none of the four strings writes mastery.estimate, mastery.band, mastery.status or system_confidence
adapters.evidence_policy: exact attempts may be imported separately when product history exposes stable event IDs, versions, results and semantic mappings; label-only state is PRODUCT_STATE_ONLY
activation_gate: product owner declares exact namespace and schema version
adapters.needs_review: No concrete course/thematic runtime namespace or state schema is repository-visible at TASK-004 time. Do not guess it.

forbidden_direct_mappings.reason: product/UI state is not canonical mastery
do not fabricate history or precision
AI evidence remains lower-trust interpreted evidence until independently validated

legacy_compatibility_findings: 102 exact attempt events are structurally adaptable; aggregate exception state is not a substitute for exact history.
120 processed_event_ids and state_revision semantics must survive import and prevent duplicate application.
114 exact handoff evidence can feed structured errors; broad task failure cannot.
114 names superseded manifest 83 while current authority is 118; this task records and adapts around the inconsistency without editing 114.
Current EGE trainer progress is item-level aggregate localStorage state and receives aggregate-only trust unless an exact session snapshot satisfies the exactness gate.
Course/thematic new/learning/review/mastered labels remain local product state; concrete runtime namespace/schema is not repository-visible and remains needs_review.
